method: Fetch each file by immutable commit using GitHub connector; compare returned UTF-8 content exactly with submitted text.
comparison: Exactly four added records files; no production paths changed.
scope: 30 actual candidates with sources, backtranslations and per-entry uncertainties; only 10 residual keys per locale.
limitations: No Android build, full tests, rendering or native-human review. Candidate wording is not independent linguistic acceptance.
